name: Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools

strategies.name: Detection of Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools

analytics.name: Analytic 1823
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App begins first-seen network connections to destinations matching known-malicious SDK C2 patterns or outside $SDKBaselineEndpoints$ for embedded SDK namespace]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

analytics.name: Analytic 1824
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: Known app begins first-seen use of protected categories (analytics, location, contacts) matching known-SDK behavior patterns post-update]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
